name: AIAgentCycle
summary: AIAgentCycle builds workflow automation, system integrations and AI agents for Dutch small and medium-sized businesses, and maintains them afterwards. The work runs on self-hosted n8n, so business data stays under the client's own control. Engagements start with a free 30-minute automation assessment; you always receive a short advice report.
legal_name: Good Nature Vibe B.V. (trading as AIAgentCycle)
key_facts: Has built production automations and web shops since 2021, from server to integration.
More than 300 automations in production, in the founder's own companies and at clients, all self-hosted.
8 servers under management, with maintenance, monitoring and backups.
The founder builds smaller projects himself; for larger projects he directs freelancers and reviews what they deliver.
Background as an NLP trainer: also coaches the people who will work with the automation.
approach: Automate one bounded process, prove the result, and only then improve. If a process is not worth automating, the client is told so.
